lines.text: A messy room. Crumbs and dust cover the floor.
@samurai strides in, a bamboo broom held like a blade.
He sweeps in one swift arc. The dust vanishes.
He slices a sponge across a smeared window. It squeaks clean.
Sunlight gleams off the spotless floor.
@samurai bows to the shining room, calm and silent.
Your home is clean. Rest now.

writes.note: I drafted a one-room scene where @samurai cleans the home like a swordsman, with one short closing line.

reply.rationale: Turned the one-line brief into a single-location 15 s scene (six action beats, one six-word line, about 14.4 s by rule 10), keeping @samurai bare.
